title: perfomance
body: 🚀 Performance – The Ultimate FPS & Optimization ModpackTired of low FPS, annoying micro-stutters, and your PC sounding like a jet engine whenever you play Minecraft? Performance is here to fix that.This modpack was built with one single goal in mind: to squeeze every single frame out of your hardware without altering the vanilla core gameplay. Forget OptiFine—welcome to the future of Minecraft optimization!⚡ Why Choose "Performance"?Massive FPS Boost: Powered by the latest, cutting-edge optimization mods (like Sodium, Lithium, and modern alternatives), giving you a massive frame rate increase.Buttery Smooth Gameplay: Say goodbye to lag spikes and micro-stutters. Perfect for multiplayer servers, massive bases, or heavy shader usage.Faster Load Times: Your game launches faster, and worlds generate in the blink of an eye.100% Vanilla Friendly: No clunky content mods or game-breaking changes. Your Minecraft stays exactly as you love it—just running at peak performance.🛠️ Key FeaturesCategoryFeatures & BenefitsGraphics EngineComplete overhaul of the rendering pipeline for triple-digit FPS.Logic & AIOptimized internal code to significantly reduce CPU load on both client and server.Memory ManagementReduced RAM consumption and optimized memory usage.Quality of LifeBuilt-in zoom feature, dynamic lights, and native shader support out of the box!📋 How to Install & UseClick Install here on the platform.For the best experience, allocate around 4 to 6 GB of RAM in your launcher settings.Launch the game, crank up your render distance, and enjoy Minecraft like never before!💡 Tip for Shader Lovers: Want beautiful graphics without sacrificing performance? Just drop your favorite shader pack into the shaderpacks folder. Thanks to the highly optimized base engine, even heavy shaders run smoother than ever!If this modpack helped boost your frames, feel free to leave a drop a like or comment! Enjoy your buttery-smooth Minecraft experience!
